programmes.funder: Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (BNDES)
programmes.amount_note: Long-term subsidised credit for innovation projects, generally from BRL 1 million upwards, financing up to 100% of eligible items for smaller companies. Also includes BNDES Funtec (non-reimbursable) for research institutions and equity via BNDESPar.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous intake; large operations are negotiated directly with BNDES and smaller ones through accredited financial agents.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the consulta prévia (preliminary enquiry) online.
BNDES assesses eligibility and assigns an analysis team.
Full application with the innovation plan and guarantees.
Credit approval, contract and staged disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Brazilian companies; collateral requirements make this hard to access for pre-revenue startups, which are better served by Finep Startup or state programmes.

programmes.name_local: EMBRAPII - Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa e Inovação Industrial
programmes.funder: Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa e Inovação Industrial (EMBRAPII)
programmes.amount_note: EMBRAPII co-funds up to one third of a company's R&D project executed with an accredited EMBRAPII research unit; the research unit contributes a further share and the company funds the balance. There is no single national ceiling - the amount is negotiated with the accredited unit.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous intake through the network of accredited EMBRAPII units, plus periodic themed calls (for example in semiconductors, health and defence).

procedure_steps.detail: Identify an accredited EMBRAPII unit whose competencies match your technology.
Co-develop the project scope and budget with that unit.
The unit submits the project for EMBRAPII approval.
Contract signed; EMBRAPII funds its share directly to the research unit and IP is negotiated in favour of the company.

documents_required.doc: Technical project scope agreed with the unit

eligibility.other_note: Brazilian companies of any size, including startups. Projects must be at TRL 3-6 and executed with an accredited EMBRAPII unit; IP typically belongs to the company.

programmes.name_local: Embrapii + Sebrae — apoio à inovação para MPMEs
programmes.name_en: EMBRAPII + Sebrae innovation support for micro, small and medium enterprises
programmes.funder: EMBRAPII (Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa e Inovação Industrial) with Sebrae
programmes.amount_note: 'Custeamos até 90% do seu projeto de inovação, sem a necessidade do reembolso dos recursos ao final do projeto.' EMBRAPII contributes up to 50% of total project value and Sebrae covers up to 70% of the company's own share. Ceilings by modality: R$ 150,000 (single MPME), R$ 200,000 (MPME with a medium/large partner), R$ 300,000 (multiple MPMEs).
programmes.deadline_note: No deadlines are published; companies engage an EMBRAPII accredited unit directly and contract when a project is scoped.

procedure_steps.detail: Define the innovation challenge.
Identify the technical expertise needed and search the network of EMBRAPII accredited units (over 90 research centres).
Meet the unit, assess viability and agree the project scope.
Negotiate and sign the contract; funds are transferred and the project is executed.

documents_required.doc: Project scope agreed with the EMBRAPII accredited unit
Proof of annual revenue up to R$ 4.8 million

eligibility.other_note: 'Micro e pequenas empresas com faturamento anual de até R$ 4,8 milhões'. Support is non-refundable ('sem a necessidade do reembolso dos recursos ao final do projeto') and is delivered as R&D services performed by EMBRAPII accredited units.

programmes.source_snippet: Custeamos até 90% do seu projeto de inovação, sem a necessidade do reembolso dos recursos ao final do projeto. ... Micro e pequenas empresas com faturamento anual de até R$ 4,8 milhões.

programmes.name_local: Programa FAPESP Pesquisa Inovativa em Pequenas Empresas (PIPE) - Fase 1
programmes.name_en: FAPESP Innovative Research in Small Business (PIPE) - Phase 1
programmes.funder: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo (FAPESP)
programmes.amount_note: Phase 1 funds technical feasibility for up to 12 months. The standing programme ceiling is BRL 300,000, but recent thematic calls (including the 2026 Jornada Tecnológica call) raised the maximum to BRL 500,000 per project, with call budgets of BRL 25-50 million.
programmes.deadline_note: PIPE has continuous flow submissions with periodic cut-off dates, plus additional thematic calls. A Phase 1 call was published on 20 May 2026 with up to BRL 25 million available.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company is based in the State of São Paulo and has no more than 250 employees.
Register the responsible researcher and the company in FAPESP's SAGe system.
Submit the Phase 1 proposal by the cut-off date.
Peer review; on approval, sign the Termo de Outorga and execute the 12-month feasibility project.
Apply for Phase 2 (up to 24 months, larger budget) on completion.

documents_required.doc: Company registration in São Paulo State
Research project with clear innovation claim
Proof of the researcher's link to the company

eligibility.other_note: Small businesses headquartered in the State of São Paulo with up to 250 employees. Research must be conducted in São Paulo State; the principal investigator must be linked to the company.

programmes.source_snippet: O valor máximo de financiamento previsto por projeto para a presente Chamada é de R$ 500.000,00

programmes.funder: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo (FAPESP)
programmes.amount_note: Phase 2 funds R&D towards a prototype or pilot for up to 24 months, historically with budgets of around BRL 1 million to BRL 1.5 million per project depending on the call.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous flow with periodic cut-off dates; normally requires successful completion of Phase 1 (or equivalent demonstrated feasibility).

procedure_steps.detail: Complete PIPE Phase 1 (or demonstrate equivalent feasibility).
Submit the Phase 2 proposal in SAGe by a cut-off date.
Peer review and site visit.
Termo de Outorga and 24-month execution.

documents_required.doc: Phase 1 final report or equivalent evidence

eligibility.other_note: Small businesses in the State of São Paulo; the same researcher-company link requirement applies.

programmes.amount_note: 'Projetos e PEIS até 30 milhões. Taxa: TR + 6,068 a 6,605% a.a.' Operated indirectly ('Operação: Indireta via parceiros') through accredited regional financial partners, which set the individual ticket. Open to companies of all revenue bands, including 'Receita: até R$ 4,8 Mi'.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous credit line ('fluxo contínuo') operated through accredited partner institutions, not a call with a closing date.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the company in the Finep cadastro system.
Identify an accredited partner financial institution operating Inovacred in your state.
Submit the innovation project and financial documentation to the partner institution for credit analysis and contracting.

documents_required.doc: Company financial statements / consolidated group financials

eligibility.other_note: Brazilian companies ('empresas brasileiras'). Objective: 'Apoiar o fomento às atividades inovativas de empresas brasileiras.' This is reimbursable credit at TR + ~6% p.a., not a grant.

programmes.source_snippet: Finep Inovacred — Objetivo: Apoiar o fomento às atividades inovativas de empresas brasileiras. Condição de financiamento: Projetos e PEIS até 30 milhões. Taxa: TR + 6,068 a 6,605% a.a. Operação: Indireta via parceiros.

programmes.amount_note: Investment via convertible instruments (mútuo conversível) in innovative Brazilian startups, historically around BRL 1 million per company, in rounds of selection announced by FINEP.
programmes.deadline_note: Finep Startup operates in numbered rounds with fixed submission windows rather than continuous intake.
programmes.reopen_note: FINEP has run successive Finep Startup rounds. New rounds are published at https://www.finep.gov.br/chamadas-publicas. Note that prior Finep Startup beneficiaries in good standing receive a 5% score bonus in Tecnova applications.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor FINEP's chamadas públicas page for an open Finep Startup round.
Submit the proposal online within the window.
Selection, negotiation and due diligence.
Convertible instrument signed and disbursed in tranches.

eligibility.other_note: Brazilian innovative startups, typically with revenue below the small-company threshold and a technology-based product.

programmes.name_local: Finep Mais Inovação Brasil - Rodada 2 - Subvenção Econômica Regional
programmes.name_en: Finep More Innovation Brazil - Round 2 - Regional Economic Subsidy
programmes.amount_note: Call budget of BRL 300 million in non-reimbursable economic subsidy for innovative products, processes or services with technological risk in the Northeast, North and Centre-West regions, supporting TRL 3 to 9. Per-project ceilings are set in the edital.
programmes.deadline_note: Proposals were due by 9 April 2026 at 17:00. Preliminary qualification results were ratified on 23 June 2026 and an updated timetable published on 3 July 2026.
programmes.reopen_note: This is Round 2 of the Finep Mais Inovação Brasil programme; FINEP has run successive rounds aligned to the Nova Indústria Brasil missions. Monitor https://www.finep.gov.br/chamadas-publicas for Round 3 and for the parallel national (non-regional) subsidy calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the company in the FINEP direct subsidy system.
Complete the online proposal form aligned to one of the six Nova Indústria Brasil missions.
Habilitação (qualification) check of documents.
Merit evaluation, then Termo de Outorga and disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Federal and social security tax clearance

eligibility.other_note: Companies with revenue up to BRL 90 million; the project must be executed in the Northeast, North or Centre-West regions and align with the Nova Indústria Brasil missions (bioeconomy, health, digital transformation, sustainable agro-industrial chains, urban infrastructure, defence/sovereignty).

programmes.source_snippet: Orçamento da chamada: R$ 300 milhões. Público-alvo: Empresas com faturamento de até R$ 90 milhões. Prazo para envio de propostas até: 09/04/2026 até as 17:00

programmes.name_en: Tecnova Programme (4th round) - decentralised innovation subsidy
programmes.funder: Financiadora de Estudos e Projetos (FINEP) / Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI)
programmes.amount_note: Fourth Tecnova round announced June 2026 with BRL 360 million from FNDCT/FINEP, rising to about BRL 588 million with state counterpart funding. In the São Paulo (FAPESP) edition each approved company received up to BRL 702,000 (BRL 600,000 for development, BRL 75,000 for acceleration, BRL 27,000 for internationalisation); other states set their own ceilings. Company counterpart is 2.5% to 10% of the subsidy depending on revenue band.
programmes.deadline_note: FINEP's deadline for state decentralised agents to submit proposals was 3 August 2026. Individual companies then apply to their own state agent (FAP, Sebrae or similar) under separate state-level editais with their own deadlines.
programmes.reopen_note: Tecnova runs in numbered rounds (Tecnova I, II, III and now IV) roughly every few years. Companies should watch their state research foundation (FAP) or Sebrae for the state-level edital that follows the national round.

procedure_steps.detail: Identify the decentralised agent for your state (state research foundation, Sebrae or development agency).
Wait for that agent to publish its state edital following the national Tecnova round.
Submit the proposal through the agent's system (for example FAPESP's SAGe).
Two-stage evaluation, technical visit, then subsidy agreement (Termo de Outorga) and staged disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Federal tax clearance certificates (CND, FGTS, CADIN)

eligibility.other_note: Brazilian companies with gross revenue up to BRL 16 million (the national round targets companies up to BRL 16 million; some FINEP calls extend to BRL 90 million). Prior Centelha, Catalisa or Finep Startup beneficiaries with a compliance letter receive a 5% score bonus.

programmes.source_snippet: A Finep e o MCTI lançaram a quarta rodada do Programa Tecnova, principal instrumento de subvenção econômica do país voltado a empresas de pequeno porte (com faturamento de até R$ 16 milhões). São R$ 360 milhões

programmes.funder: FINEP, CNPq and MCTI with state research foundations (FAPs)
programmes.amount_note: Each selected idea receives around BRL 50,000 in non-reimbursable economic subsidy, plus a CNPq technical support scholarship to strengthen the founding team.
programmes.deadline_note: Centelha runs in national editions (Centelha I, II and III) which are then implemented through state-level editais, each with its own window.
programmes.reopen_note: Centelha 3 is the current edition. Each state research foundation (FAP) opens its own call under the national edition, so the window depends on your state. Register at programacentelha.com.br to be notified when your state's call opens.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Centelha platform and select your state.
Submit the idea in the first phase (online form, open to individuals).
Selected ideas progress to a business plan phase with training.
Winners incorporate a company and receive the subsidy plus a CNPq scholarship.

eligibility.other_note: Open to individuals and very early teams resident in the participating state; the company is created during the programme.

programmes.source_snippet: Os empreendedores receberão cerca de R$ 50 mil na forma de subvenção econômica.

programmes.amount_note: Programme supporting researchers and science and technology institutions (ICTs) to turn research into businesses, with training, mentoring and connection to funding. Cash awards vary by state edition.
programmes.deadline_note: Runs through state Sebrae units with their own editais and windows.
programmes.reopen_note: Catalisa ICT runs annually through state Sebrae units. Prior Catalisa beneficiaries in good standing receive a 5% score bonus in FINEP Tecnova applications, so completion certificates are worth keeping.

procedure_steps.detail: Check your state Sebrae for the open Catalisa ICT edital.
Apply with the research-based venture idea.
Selection and training track.
Connection to investors and public funding instruments.

eligibility.other_note: Researchers and spin-offs linked to Brazilian science and technology institutions.

programmes.funder: Sebrae (Serviço Brasileiro de Apoio às Micro e Pequenas Empresas) with the Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços
programmes.amount_note: Free, equity-free national acceleration programme: mentoring, online training and demo day exposure to investors and corporates. It does not pay cash to participants.
programmes.deadline_note: Runs in cycles (historically two per year) with fixed application windows announced on inovativabrasil.com.br.
programmes.reopen_note: InovAtiva has run two cycles a year in most years, with applications typically opening early in each semester. It also runs vertical editions (InovAtiva de Impacto, InovAtiva Indústria). Register on the platform to be notified.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the InovAtiva platform during an open cycle.
Complete the online application describing the solution and traction.
Selection into the acceleration cycle.
Online training, mentoring rounds and demo day.

eligibility.other_note: Brazilian startups and innovative projects; open to pre-incorporation teams in some cycles. Free of charge and equity-free.
